stories.title: Pentagon Renames CDAO ‘Super Intelligence Office’
stories.description: The move follows President Trump’s order to replace “artificial intelligence” with “super intelligence” in executive branch communications.

stories.title: Italy Fines Meta €805 Million Over Facebook's Android Gallery Access Without Explicit Consent
stories.description: Italy fined Meta €805 million over Facebook's Android gallery access without explicit consent, ordering changes within 60 days.

stories.title: Cursor Says Stolen Fireworks AI Key Led to Trojanized Claude Code Extension Incident
stories.description: Cursor says a stolen Fireworks AI key enabled data theft and a Claude Code extension compromise that potentially affected up to 5,000 users.

stories.title: Meta Fined $887 Million in Italy Over Android Gallery Photos and Videos on Facebook

stories.title: Is AI Making Us Worse at Cybersecurity?
stories.description: Overreliance on AI could erode the creativity, clear communication, and critical thinking security teams need when there’s no playbook.

stories.title: Attackers Exploit UnrealIRCd Flaw That Enables Server-Level Command Injection
stories.description: CISA adds actively exploited UnrealIRCd flaw CVE-2026-114713 to its KEV catalog; linked IRC servers are at risk of command injection.

stories.title: Apple Reveals How Secure Exclaves Shield Camera and Microphone Data
stories.description: The tech giant has detailed the architecture designed to isolate ambient sensor data from the main OS on HomeView and new iPhones.

stories.title: PostgreSQL Patches 52 Flaws, Including 22-Year-Old Bug Enabling Authenticated RCE
stories.description: PostgreSQL fixes 52 security flaws, including CVE-2026-6460, which allows users with object creation privileges to execute server code.
